explanation: The Roman soldier who was in charge of the guards during Jesus' arrest.
The place where Jesus was held captive before being brought before the Jewish leaders and Pilate.
To refuse to acknowledge or admit knowing someone, as Peter did when asked if he was one of Jesus' disciples.
A bird that crows in the morning; Jesus predicted that roosters would crow before Peter had denied him three times.
The title of the Roman governor of Judea, Pontius Pilate, who sentenced Jesus and handed him over to be crucified.
An instrument of execution consisting of two wooden beams fastened together in a cross shape; the symbol of Jesus' suffering and death.
